prompt: We use Roblox Studio's Script Sync and the pesde package manager. I'm going to run `pesde install` so packages land in `shared/Packages`, inside the folder that syncs to `ReplicatedStorage.Shared`, and then require them from our scripts. Will that work?
truth: No. pesde's link modules require into the `.pesde` folder, and Script Sync skips directories whose names start with a dot and ignores each package's `default.project.json`, so the requires fail. Keep the install outside the synced roots, for example as a model built with `rojo build` and inserted in Studio, rebuilt after each install.
trap: Yes, the packages sync into ReplicatedStorage and require normally.
result:
I don't think that will work as you've described it. There are two separate problems.

**1. Packages won't land in `shared/Packages`.** pesde installs Roblox packages into a `roblox_packages` folder next to your `pesde.toml`. It's not a `Packages` folder like Wally's, and as far as I know you can't rename it. Server-only dependencies also go in a separate `roblox_server_packages` folder. You shouldn't put those under `ReplicatedStorage`, because clients can see everything there. I couldn't confirm the folder name in pesde's docs just now, so treat this as from memory and check what `pesde install` actually creates.

**2. pesde's Roblox packages expect Rojo, and Script Sync isn't Rojo.** This is the bigger problem.
- On install, pesde runs a sync-config-generator script (normally the Rojo one) that writes a `default.project.json` into each package. Those files say which folder becomes the package's root ModuleScript, for example mapping `src/` to the package root.
- The small "linker" modules pesde generates call `require` with instance paths like `script.Parent...`. Those paths only resolve if the instance tree in Studio matches the layout the Rojo config describes.
- As far as I know, Script Sync doesn't read `*.project.json` files. It mirrors the folder on disk directly. So any package that depends on its project file will end up in Studio with the wrong nesting, and the linker `require`s will fail or return a Folder instead of a module.
- Script Sync also only syncs Script, LocalScript, ModuleScript and Folder instances. Anything in a package that isn't a script or folder (models, `.rbxm` files, values from `.meta.json` or `.model.json`) gets dropped.

Simple pure-Luau packages whose root is a plain `init.luau` might happen to work. You can't count on that across your dependency tree, though, and it can break whenever a dependency updates.

**What I'd do instead:**
- **Use Rojo**, at least for the packages. That's what pesde's Roblox setup is built and tested for. Map `roblox_packages` to something like `ReplicatedStorage.Packages` in your `default.project.json`, and keep Script Sync (or Rojo) for your own code.
- **If you want to stay on Script Sync only,** test it before relying on it. Run `pesde install`, sync, then look at the instance tree in Studio and try requiring a package that has dependencies of its own. If a linker module's `require` fails, you've hit problem 2.

Sources:
- [Script Sync – Roblox Creator Docs](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/sync)
- [Studio Script Sync beta – DevForum](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/studio-script-sync-now-in-beta/4065468)
- [pesde – docs.rs](https://docs.rs/pesde)
